scope: Two failure-selected exposed train states. Conditional fixed Host readout, not complete autonomous tasks or representative training collection.
finding: Both original empty handoffs had an actually executed successful source path within the original limits. Finite branches do not exhaust all possible strategies.
view_findings: One core-correct but qualified View/readout; one wrong Host readout that overinterprets liking a backup. View temporal flaws and Host consumption errors remain separate.
preference_scope: No automatic labels for untested actions and no claim that delivery feedback beats answer-only feedback.
